create_transformed_distribution: create a Transformed distribution by wrapping a base distribution with a bijector like tfb.Scale
test_sample_and_log_prob: test sampling and computing log probability from a Transformed distribution with a Tanh bijector
test_kl_divergence: test KL divergence between two Transformed distributions using Identity or Lambda bijectors
test_batched_bijector_shapes: test batched bijector shapes with Block-wrapped bijectors across multiple batch dimensions
test_jittable_transformed: test that a Transformed distribution log_prob call is JAX JIT compilable
